items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Langford had told us about the use of kerosene to clean the pistons... he gave us a bit of theory... Mr. Langford, of course, was always an inspiration

ctx.x: Yeah, but those days, I mean, that would be worth $50 now.

I guess it would be really. So, I got this old cornet and in fact they got it for me and I got me some BonAmi. And it was all black where it had been tarnished, you know, and the valves wouldn't work. So, Mr. Langford had told us about the use of kerosene to clean the pistons and all those things to run it through, you know. And, of course, Ivory soap to run it through. And I shined that horn and I shined that horn and we had a little wood shed in the backyard and I used to go out there to do my wood shedding and…
